This year falls outside that cycle, so no regular mayoral election was held. The Wayne County Clerk results index for this period was opened and lists no Detroit mayoral special election in this year.

A mayoral general election was held in Detroit on November 5, 2013 (four-year cycle under the charter, consistent with the 2017 and 2021 elections). The previously cited PDF (also reachable at detroitmi.gov/sites/detroitmi.localhost/files/2018-05/...) is a Wayne County Board of Canvassers Write-In Report for Mayor of Detroit. It lists only precinct-level write-in names and does not show Duggan, Napoleon or citywide totals. Searches for an official county, city or state results document failed: the Wayne County clerk 2013 URL guess returned 404, the detroitmi.gov election-results pages returned 404 or a dynamic app, miboecfr.nictusa.com returned 403, and mielections.us did not respond. The year is left unresolved because no official source with the vote totals was opened.

An August nonpartisan primary preceded this general election and is an earlier round. The general election decided the office. Winner and runner-up are in detroit_results.json.
